icon-d2-grib2-v1.measurement: Maximum level-1 pressure across four real native-composed frames on the declared normalized window.

warm_season_reference.title: AFGL Atmospheric Constituent Profiles (0-120km)
warm_season_reference.basis: The 20700.925 m mass height lies between the standard July rows. Log-pressure interpolation gives 5340.63 Pa; the 20 km row supplies a conservative 5950 Pa bound for this reference column, independent of the configured top. This climatology is not a measured extreme-weather envelope.

hrrr-native-grib2-v1.measurement: Minimum, mean and maximum of PRES on hybrid level 50 (the top mass level the mapping reads) in the real f000 record of each cycle, read with ecCodes grib_get from the record the .idx byte range names; the three were equal in every cycle.
hrrr-native-grib2-v1.coverage_rule: measured top-level pressure of a pressure-based hybrid coordinate
hrrr-native-grib2-v1.basis: The coordinate is pure pressure at its top, so the top level's pressure is the same constant at every column and in every season measured (January, July, August, September, October); no height-to-pressure climatology enters the bound.
